items.reason: Reject invalid directly bound text/font values before a live patch changes any properties.
Update actual text layer state and original-box layout when direct text/font bindings change.
Recompute both grown and shrunken bound text quads instead of retaining a previous larger canvas.
Draw the updated text texture in the acknowledged frame, including a single paused forced frame.
Text scripts and texture updates run once before drawing rather than after the frame is already visible.
An older asynchronous frame can resolve only the waiters captured before that draw.
Track pending and active frame batches so errors and disposal reject every affected promise.
Destroy rejects a queued paused frame even when no renderer completion will run afterward.
Propagate the actual rendering promise through the existing scene property transport.
Public data-only updates use the same real playing/paused frame mechanism as Editor updates.
Callers may await data acceptance and actual drawing without receiving Editor controls.
Bundle the same lossless source-origin and typed runtime modules into every pinned renderer copy.
Carry the exact effect material bytes into the engine-owned source registry.
Keep one source-aware runtime beside the existing inline constant evaluator.
A failed external evaluation must not write its authored static value or a shader default.
Evaluate authenticated external wrappers before the legacy inline constant path.
Run owned material wrappers for the actual mesh/per-mesh consumer without rebuilding geometry.
Rebind constants for adjacent meshes that share a shader program but use different material resources.
Use the current typed resource values when binding a custom particle material shader.
Expose a focused renderer injection point while keeping the owning mount responsible for disposal.
Bind returned resource byte identities to their logical package/loose paths.
Capture original material bytes before user-property mutation and retain one frame context for non-renderer sinks.
Authenticate material wrappers against exact original bytes and logical paths before normal resolver mutations.
Pass direct material bytes through the same source capture used by effect materials.
Evaluate generic tint wrappers in place and preserve the last visible value when an external script fails.
Apply one coherent tint result only when every authored component evaluated successfully.
Include the validated engine-owned source descriptor in issue identity and public records.
Preserve the optional eighth issue field without changing legacy inline records.
Capture each exact particle document before compiling emitters or child overrides.
Apply typed child overrides, emitter rates and particle material constants before advancing the existing pool.
Construct one owner-scoped runtime with the same scene environment and lifecycle hooks as inline constants.
Let authenticated resource constants consume animation events through their typed state.
Update non-renderer sinks with the same frame clock and screen state before drawing.
Deliver current user properties to every owned resource sandbox before the next frame.
Dispose every external sandbox and timer owned by removed layer consumers.
